study.name: Retest: Phase 2c: H8 Library Composition — Track 2 (brief-text)
study.description:
Tests 5 library compositions at the best text-only M/E from Phase 2a
(brief-text, F1=0.5425) and optimal temperature from Phase 2b (T=0.0,
F1=0.6602). This track explores whether library composition effects
differ between text-only and image-using modalities.

Dual-track context: brief-text unexpectedly outperformed all image-using
conditions in Phase 2a, but no pairwise differences survived FDR correction.
Both M/E levels are carried forward independently. See Decision 16.

Text-only prompts have a substantially smaller context window (no base64
images), which may cause different sensitivity to library composition
compared to the image-using track.
study.retest_notes: H8 library composition Track 2 (text-only). All at T=0.0.
